commentary.text: 90+11' Gael Angoula is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+8' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
90+8' Strasbourg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+7' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Strasbourg are awarded a corner kick.
90+6' Lorient seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90+4' Shots on target – 2:2.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' The match can continue after the interruption.
89' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.

87' Noah Cadiou (Lorient) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
84' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
82' Here is a change. Samir El Mourabet is going off and Liam Rosenior gives the last tactical orders to Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg).
81' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) pings a header narrowly wide of the left post from around the penalty spot following a decent cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
80' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
79' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
77' The corner by Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sebastian Nanasi trots off the pitch and is replaced by Martial Godo (Strasbourg).
75' Liam Rosenior has decided to substitute Julio Enciso and he is replaced by Kendry Paez (Strasbourg).
75' Olivier Pantaloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Noah Cadiou (Lorient) replacing Jean-Victor Makengo.
75' Substitution. Pablo Pagis leaves the pitch and is replaced by Dermane Karim (Lorient).
72' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Mike Penders to dive and make a save.
71' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle. Lorient have been awarded a free kick.
68' Strasbourg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
66' Olivier Pantaloni prepares a substitution. Theo Le Bris is replaced by Joel Mvuka Mugisha (Lorient).
66' Substitution. Sambou Soumano makes his way off the pitch and Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) comes on as his replacement.
64' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

62' Pablo Pagis (Lorient) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Gael Angoula with no other option than to blow for a foul.

60' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
59' The resulting corner from Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) is cleared.

58' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Diego Moreira (Strasbourg) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
53' 59:41 – the ratio of ball possession.
50' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) was quite harsh and Gael Angoula didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
50' Neat passing move from Lorient in order to create new attacking opportunities.
47' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
47' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Liam Rosenior gives a chance to Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) and Mamadou Sarr is off.
45' Gael Angoula has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
44' Sambou Soumano (Lorient) fires a shot well wide of the right post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
43' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
41' Strasbourg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
40' Bamo Meite (Lorient) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.

39' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) decides to take on a mid-range shot after a rebound falls into his path, but he was unbalanced and the shot subsequently goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Strasbourg will have a goal kick.
39' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lorient.

38' What an opportunity! Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the resulting free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
37' Lorient have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
34' Strasbourg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

33' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) wins some space for himself around the penalty spot and manages to produce a promising header. One of the defenders stops his effort before it gets to the goalkeeper, making him redundant. Strasbourg force their opponents to concede a corner.
32' The resulting set piece from Lorient is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

31' A nice pass finds Laurent Abergel (Lorient) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic shot from distance that looks bound for the top right corner, but Mike Penders pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him. The ball is out of play. Lorient win a corner kick.
29' Lorient take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

28' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The referee points to the corner flag and Lorient will take a corner.
26' Sambou Soumano (Lorient) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
25' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
22' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
22' Arsene Kouassi (Lorient) jumps into a tackle and Gael Angoula signals a foul. Strasbourg will take a free kick.
21' The corner is swung in but Strasbourg can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

20' Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but his fine header towards the underside of the crossbar is perfectly saved by the goalkeeper. The linesman makes the right call and Strasbourg will have a corner.
20' The ball goes out of play and it will be a corner kick.
20' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Strasbourg have been awarded a corner kick.
17' Strasbourg keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
15' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) tries to find Guela Doue, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
14' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
13' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
12' Strasbourg control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

10' Joaquin Panichelli (Strasbourg) meets a cross from the flank and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies totally wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
8' Lorient are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.

5' Jean-Victor Makengo (Lorient) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Strasbourg.
4' The Lorient players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
2' Strasbourg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' The match has just started.
Lorient will kick-off.
